verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships Tracking Plans that "monitor and act on non-compliant event data at the source," and its data-quality page describes predefined tracking plans that catch issues in transit and "fix and filter data before it impact downstream teams." That covers enforcement with flagging and filtering, i.e. blocking. Event schemas within Tracking Plans can also be reviewed via MCP. missing for 10: detailed docs on specific violation-handling modes (block vs. flag vs. quarantine/dead-letter routing), documentation of how violation reports are surfaced, independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works as claimed.
